lessons.applicability: Replacing named slot pointers with direct array reads and writes in guarded nested loops restored the outer cursor and inner snapshot, reducing this source pair from 48 to 18 differing words. A separate named-pointer dump rejects a hoisted address's induction reduction; its user-variable copy cost supports a bounded explanation. This is source-bound evidence, not the winning source's internal pass trace. Preserve genuine accesses; never add dummy consumers.

Real X-before-Z expression phases restore local F0/F2 in nonmatching 3C0; its missing SCHED2 capture leaves the first changing pass unproved. Separate counterexample 6186 retains four divisions/casts through SCHED2, then shares at JUMP2. Its arm-local result declarations still become GLOBAL allocnos with a V0 conflict. Keep pass claims source-bound: block scope does not guarantee local allocation. Preserve real paths and operations; improved registers do not establish a match.

At real read/value/reload boundaries, a typed local work word can carry successive cursor and numeric values without extra operations. In the documented 681A precursor, genuine helper-load and increment producers gave the work value A0/V1 preferences, leaving the tag in A1 and removing four instruction-field differences. Preserve every load/store and phase lifetime; never add fake uses. The trace belongs to this precursor, which still had an unrelated address bug, not the later accepted source.

Equivalent minimum conditionals can preserve every relocation-masked instruction field while exchanging the external objects loaded. In this source pair, reversing the comparison and matching result arms restored actual address bindings without changing text extent or table bytes. Check real symbols and implicit addends; field agreement alone is insufficient. The earlier source remains a counterexample. This is bounded source evidence, not a general operand-order rule.

Separate genuine definitions of one argument in existing paths can prevent loop hoisting. In this clean nonmatching example, RTL/LOOP/FLOW retain four definitions; allocation then selects the wrong register and delay filling duplicates the constants into unwanted slots. The overall candidate regresses despite resolving hoisting. Preserve actual calls, producers and path behavior; do not invent assignments or consumers. Stage progress alone does not select a best candidate or establish transfer.

Compare genuine array-member indexing or a local indexed address with assignment to a shared cursor. In this clean nonmatching context, the shared cursor retained an extra saved-register copy; direct member indexing equaled the local form and restored the aggregate base plus member displacement. Source-bound loop dumps explain the terminal induction reduction. Preserve actual layout, bounds and operation order; the counterexample does not isolate an allocation stage or prove general transfer.

Equivalent real loop guards can retain different compiler comparison pseudos. In this clean nonmatching pair, index<count survives FLOW, becomes a USE in COMBINE and receives an eight-byte slot during allocation; count>0 loses it and shrinks the frame. Inspect source-bound stages before inferring a missing field. Preserve real index/bound producers, widths and zero-iteration behavior; never manufacture references or padding. Transfer and whole-function acceptance remain unproved.

A shared arithmetic result can inherit a spill register or let later loads move early. In this clean nonmatching example, real multiply/divide/store tails in alternative arms retained a join through allocation; late-jump then merged the tails while preserving the inserted reload. Compare the shared-quotient counterexample and source-bound dumps. Preserve executed operations and real conditions; this is local compiler evidence, not original-source proof or whole-function acceptance.

Final delay-slot placement can hide the earlier lifetime used for allocation. In this clean nonmatching source pair, placing the real index initialization inside its guard restored register homes; initializing the actual packet base before the next guard supplied its delay slot. Source-bound allocation, sched2 and dbr dumps distinguish these stages. Preserve real uses and zero-iteration behavior; local instruction correspondence is not whole-function acceptance or a universal recipe.

If a real pointer disappears into a biased induction variable, inspect loop-pass combination and profitability. Moving its genuine increment into existing alternative paths prevented reduction in this clean nonmatching example and restored base-plus-field addressing. Preserve one increment per original path and operation order. Baseline evidence is native-only; stage facts belong to the changed source. When a scalar or pointer spans distinct real producers, compare phases at existing reloads or lifetime boundaries, preserving zero-iteration and retained-value consumers. In this clean nonmatching loop context, phase separation restored several register and stack assignments; the loop-form-only control worsened allocation despite the intended relative order. Inspect the full allocation, not a two-variable ratio. No invented uses or runtime work; no original-source or whole-match claim.

Earlier-zero control B834 restores those homes but puts the zero at the wrong site; 5E is the unchanged control. Counts, ordering and homes are measured; priority ratios are explanatory, not traced allocation decisions. Preserve genuine reads and consumers, inspect full allocation/placement, and retain unresolved terminal sharing. All examples remain nonmatching.
